newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka gains in year-end dull session.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka gains in year-end dull session.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka gained on a year-end slump in dollar demand and finished at 42.5370/5400 to the U.S. currency in interbank trading, against the previous close of 42.5440/5460, dealers said.
The local currency was quoted at 42.5420/5470 to the dollar in early trade. There were very few deals and most were done at the 42.5400 level, dealers said.
They said most players were absent from trading, with banks preoccupied with last-minute reviews of their positions ahead of Tuesday's year-end closure.
The interbank call money rate traded at 6.0-6.5 percent against Sunday's 5.0-6.0 percent, dealers said.
